class.name: SteamScreenshotRequest
class.brief_description: Branchable screenshot draft created from a game-owned image.
class.description: Each edit returns a new draft. Steam receives the image only when an explicit submission starts. Location and tags are submitted after the exact save is confirmed.

method.name: at
method.description: Return a copy with the optional location label. Pass empty text to omit it. Steam accepts at most 255 UTF-8 bytes without embedded NUL characters.

method.name: send
method.description: Submit the draft once and return a retained operation. The scope validates all input before writing, waits up to 15 seconds for the exact save confirmation, and then applies requested metadata. A timeout does not cancel the Steam write.

method.name: submit
method.description: Submit the draft once. Await this call for a [SteamScreenshotResult], including immediate validation or availability failures.

method.name: tag
method.description: Return a copy with an individual decimal SteamID64 tag. Submission rejects a malformed ID or more than 32 user tag requests. Duplicate IDs are submitted once.

method.name: tag_item
method.description: Return a copy with a nonzero decimal Workshop published-file ID. Submission rejects a malformed ID or more than 32 item tag requests. Duplicate IDs are submitted once.
